name: MGSM: Multilingual Grade School Math Benchmark
description: MGSM (Multilingual Grade School Math) is an evaluation benchmark designed to assess multilingual mathematical reasoning and chain-of-thought prompting across 11 diverse, typologically distinct languages: English (en), Bengali (bn), German (de), Spanish (es), French (fr), Japanese (ja), Russian (ru), Swahili (sw), Telugu (te), Thai (th), and Chinese (zh). It contains 250 grade-school math word problems selected from the GSM8K test set, professionally translated into 10 target languages (yielding 2,750 translated problem items total) plus 8 few-shot exemplars with culturally adapted step-by-step chain-of-thought reasoning paths per language.
